{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate: keep highest sample_seq per patient_id
df_dedup = df.sort_values('sample_seq', ascending=False).drop_duplicates(subset='patient_id', keep='first')

# Filter for treatment arm only
treatment_only = df_dedup[df_dedup['arm'] == 'treatment']

# Compute fraction who responded
responded_count = treatment_only['responded'].sum()
total_treatment = len(treatment_only)
fraction_responded = responded_count / total_treatment

# Print all required numbers
print(f"responded_count = {responded_count}")
print(f"total_treatment = {total_treatment}")
print(f"fraction_responded = {fraction_responded}")
print(f"rounded_fraction = {fraction_responded:.3f}")"}
